assertions.subject: Vertebral osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: the fraction of cases of vertebral osteomyelitis acquired in association with health care is certainly increasing

assertions.subject: Vertebral osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: Vertebral osteomyelitis is typically classified as pyogenic or nonpyogenic

assertions.subject: Vertebral osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: macroscopic pus formation (caseous necrosis, abscess) is quite common

assertions.subject: Acute vertebral osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: 20% by gram-negative bacilli—mainly Escherichia coli (9%) and Pseudomonas aeruginosa (6%)

assertions.subject: Subacute vertebral osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: Subacute vertebral osteomyelitis is typically caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis or Brucella species

assertions.subject: Vertebral osteomyelitis due to Candida species
assertions.quote: the diagnosis is often delayed by several weeks

assertions.subject: Implant-associated spinal osteomyelitis
assertions.quote: coagulase-negative staphylococci and P. acnes—which, in the absence of an implant, are generally considered contaminants—typically cause low-grade (chronic) infections
